result.note: Tested the competing India and Bangladesh positions on the Ganges treaty renewal: bilateralism versus international forums.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, Bangladesh set out its demands for the renewal of the Ganges water-sharing treaty with India. Consider the following statements:
items: Bangladesh ruled out raising its demand for a minimum-flow guarantee at international forums.
India views the issue as a bilateral one and resists third-party mediation.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because Bangladesh threatened to take the matter to international forums if it did not get a binding minimum-flow guarantee. India resists this, since it treats the treaty as a bilateral matter and rejects third-party mediation.
questions.source: a demand India resists because it views the issue to be a bilateral one and resists third-party mediation
